query: I just had a long conversation with Claude on the web about building a real-time audio streaming pipeline for our USV recordings. It came up with a solid 6-step plan covering the DAQ interface, ring buffer, STFT engine, detection layer, websocket server, and React viewer. Can you turn that into something I can actually build step by step? The conversation is saved at docs/plans/streaming-pipeline-plan.md
hey so I brainstormed with claude.ai about how to add UMAP dimensionality reduction to our feature extraction pipeline and it gave me 4 phases. can you make this implementable? I'll paste it below

I have a design doc at docs/plans/labeling-tool-redesign.md that outlines rebuilding the labeling UI with PyQt6 instead of Streamlit. It has 5 major steps but they're pretty high level. I need this converted into the /implement format we use so each module is self-contained and a fresh session can pick it up.
roadmap from PLAN_classifier_training.md

I wrote up some rough notes on adding Zarr v3 support and chunked storage for our spectrogram cache. It's not really a formal plan, more like a brainstorm with some pseudocode. But I'd like to structure these steps for building -- maybe 3-4 modules with test plans and dependencies mapped out.

convert this plan into a roadmap:

Phase 1: Add bandpass filter (25-125 kHz) before STFT
Phase 2: Replace current energy detector with adaptive threshold
Phase 3: Add harmonic analysis for call classification
Phase 4: Export results in DeepSqueak-compatible format

ok I've been going back and forth with web Claude about the best approach for building a training data pipeline and we settled on a 5-step plan. I saved the whole chat to a file. Can you take that plan and make each step into one of those implement blocks so I can hand them off to separate coding sessions?
I need to take the vacation scheduling feature plan from our last planning session and break it down into implementable modules. The plan is in my clipboard, let me paste it...

here's an implementation plan I got from ChatGPT for adding a spectrogram comparison tool. Can you restructure it into our ROADMAP format? It has steps for loading, alignment, diff computation, and visualization.
Turn the contents of bootsnap_integration_plan.md into structured implementation steps. I want each phase to have its own /implement block with test plans, dependencies, and review tiers.
implement phase 14.1 from ROADMAP.md -- the spectrogram cache invalidation module. All the specs are already in the roadmap, just build it.
what's the current status of the ROADMAP? which phases are done and which are still pending? I want to know what we've accomplished so far in the USV pipeline.
Can you update ROADMAP.md to mark Phase 8.3 as DONE and add a note about the VQ-VAE hidden state approach we chose? Also bump the next phase number.
I want to plan out how we should approach adding multi-channel audio support. I don't have a plan yet -- can you help me think through the architecture? What components would need to change?
review the ROADMAP_PARTS_FINDER.md file and tell me if the test plans are thorough enough. Are there any edge cases we're missing? I want a quality check before we start implementing.
We need a product roadmap for the next quarter. What features should we prioritize? Consider the detection accuracy improvements, the labeling tool, and the training pipeline.
Run /implement on Step 3 from ROADMAP_STREAMING_VIEWER.md. The STFT streaming engine module -- just build it according to the spec that's already there.
I have two roadmap files -- ROADMAP_INFRA_IMPROVEMENTS.md and ROADMAP_CLI_CONSOLIDATION.md -- and some of the modules overlap. Can you help me merge them and resolve the dependency conflicts?
Can you create a project timeline or gantt chart from our ROADMAP.md? I need to present our progress and upcoming work to the lab PI next week.
I need to write a plan for adding GPU-accelerated STFT processing. Help me think through the steps -- I want to use CuPy for the FFT and compare performance against our current NumPy implementation.
